answer: Pawnbroker custody turns identity into locked collateral. A licensed vault appraises an object, perhaps a pearl strand or a vine-dresser's antique press, seals it, and signs one agent key against its assay record. Paperwork for a sold meadow or mere photos never count; the item stays inside. Required appraised value doubles with each key redeemed by the same payer, and monthly storage interest keeps every extra head bleeding money.
